product_metadata.title: Farberware 12-Piece Non-Stick Resin, Dishwasher-Safe Kitchen Knife Set with Custom-Fit Blade Covers, Razor-Sharp, Multicolor
features: Stick resistant: Each blade is crafted from stainless steel and features a stick resistant, resin coating that limits food from adhering to the knife; this allows for easier, more efficient cutting
Comfortable grip & balance: The ergonomically designed handles are designed for a comfortable grip; knives are perfectly balanced for precision while cutting

Perfect set for back to college: Best gift for new college students, grads, newlyweds, or anyone setting up a first time kitchen; A great set for those who know their way around a kitchen as it is or for newbie chefs just learning the ropes.

12 Piece value kitchen knife set: This set includes: 8 inch chef knife, 8 inch bread knife, 8 inch slicing knife, 5.5 inch serrated utility knife, and 3.5 inch paring knife; each knife includes a blade cover.
Easy to clean: This set is dishwasher safe, making clean up fast and easy, however hand washing is recommended to extend product life; limited lifetime warranty
description: This Farberware 12 Piece Resin Knife Set is a vibrant addition to your kitchen and includes all the essential knives for everyday food prep tasks. Knives feature a resin coating that keeps food from sticking to the blades, and the ergonomically designed handle provides comfort while cutting. Each knife includes a blade cover to keep blades safe and secure when in storage. 12 piece set includes: 8 inch Chef Knife with blade cover, 8 inch Slicing Knife with blade cover, 8 inch Bread Knife with blade cover, 7 inch Santoku Knife with blade cover, 5-1/2 inch Serrated Utility Knife with blade cover, and 3-1/2 inch Paring Knife with blade cover. Hand-wash with warm water and a mild detergent; rinse and dry immediately.
